raw_translation: An sarrafa hotuna cikin gida kuma ba a tura su ko a adana su. Wannan zai samar da hoton takardar sticker kawai; ba zai cire bango na hotuna ba, samar da kwamfutoci na shirin ayuka na aika-da-saƙo, wallafa stickers ko shigar da su cikin shirin ayuka. Yi amfani da zane-zane da kake da izinin amfani da su.
source: Images are processed locally and are not uploaded or saved. This creates a sticker sheet image only; it does not remove image backgrounds, create messaging-app packs, publish stickers or install them in an app. Use artwork you have permission to use.
